name: claude-mem-cursor
description: Persistent memory for Cursor. Hooks ingest tool use; MCP searches past sessions. Works with a local worker or a remote cmem.ai worker, and a local host-login observer or remote inference.

CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_URL.title: Remote MCP URL
CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_URL.description: Leave empty for a local worker (stdio). Set to https://cmem.ai/api/mcp (or your server) for remote.

CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_TOKEN.title: Remote MCP token
CLAUDE_MEM_MCP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for remote MCP. Unused for local worker.
